#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

payload="$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"

title=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d.get('pull_request',{}).get('title',''))" "$payload")
body=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d.get('pull_request',{}).get('body',''))" "$payload")

if [[ "$title$body" =~ #[0-9]+ ]]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi
